agent_explanation: Actuated NS green started ~step 430 and was still held at step 627 (~197s, well over max_green 86s). While S detector_fail active from t=511 the controller cannot see S queue and mis-handles gap-out/max-out/recall: it keeps serving NS (N has real queue 54-59) and never recalls to EW, so E waits red with queued vehicles from wait 4 to 201, breaching max_wait 200. Fixed-time control of identical demand terminates the green and avoids the violation.
